events.title: Post PMC Celebration!!
events.description: Come celebrate Jude's 50 mile ride for the PMC!

events.title: Salt Bread and Coffee pop-up
events.description: Ride with us from the lovely Boston Common to Newbery St. Coffee pop up cafe in Brookline Village. Travel through Fenway and the riverway on this route.

events.title: Too Hot to Handle
events.description:
You are cordially invited to an Indian food dinner party at mine! I will be making the mains and apps but please feel free to bring a dish or a drink!. Just showing up for the good food + vibes is totally a valid option!

If guest count exceeds 8-10 we will move to a nearby park - please keep an eye out for venue changes! 😄

events.title: The journey is really the best part
events.location: KoKo Coffee, 226 Causeway St, Boston, MA
events.description: Yippee! Another Saturday, another ride. This time from Lower Allston over to Koko coffee.

events.title: Let’s go to Localito
events.location: Localito Cafe, 30 Riverside Ave, Medford, MA
events.description:
Come out and explore your city… or another city right next door!

This gorgeous little ride will take us from Charlestown up to Localito Cafe in Medford.
